newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sees $43 mln oil-backed bonds in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sees $43 mln oil-backed bonds in Feb.

text.p: The first issue of oil bonds backed by Venezuelan state-owned oil company PdVSA will be for 20 billion bolivars ($43 million) and will probably take place in February, top PdVSA officials said.

Although the bonds will be used to finance oil projects, "our primary aim is clear and simple: to promote Venezuelans' participation in the oil industry," said Angel Olmeta, president of PdVSA affiliate, the Oil Investment Fund (Sofip).
"Our target is the small investor," he added. Venezuelans will be able to buy the bonds through a network of national banks, he said.
